name: Helen Keller International
mission: Guided by our founder’s remarkable legacy, Helen Keller Intl works to improve the lives of people around the world by protecting vision, enhancing nutrition, and fighting disease.
theoryOfChange: Helen Keller International has a published multiyear strategy titled 'Leading Locally, Fortifying Futures' [2, 5]. This document outlines their vision for 'A world where every person can live a healthy life filled with potential' and their mission to protect vision, improve nutrition, and fight disease [2, 5]. The strategy details their core program areas, including Sound Nutrition, Clear Vision, and Neglected Tropical Diseases [2]. It also describes two critical changes they aim to drive: improving the reach and quality of health services, and expanding access to safe, nutritious, and fortified foods for underserved communities [5]. The strategy emphasizes strengthening health systems, fortifying foods, and prioritizing local voices and solutions to achieve their impact goals [2, 5].

strengths_deep_dive: Helen Keller International demonstrates rigorous financial discipline and operational efficiency. In FY2024, the charity maintained a <cite id="8">81.2% program expense ratio</cite>, ensuring that the vast majority of resources directly fund global health operations. Furthermore, Charity Navigator awarded the organization an <cite id="1">overall score of 99.5/100</cite>, citing a perfect 100 on Culture and a 99 on Accountability and Finance. Their fundraising efficiency is particularly notable, requiring just <cite id="1">$0.03 per $1 raised</cite>, allowing charitable contributions to go further in treating vision loss and malnutrition.
rich_narrative.summary: Helen Keller International works globally to prevent blindness and eliminate malnutrition through high-impact public health interventions <cite id="14">across Asia, Africa, and the Americas</cite>. Founded in <cite id="14">1915</cite>, the organization implements large-scale programs focusing on vision restoration, vitamin A supplementation, and neglected tropical disease control. In FY2024, the charity generated <cite id="8">$75,653,633 in total revenue</cite>, reflecting a operational consolidation following prior post-pandemic funding cycles. Operating with high efficiency, Helen Keller International directed <cite id="8">81.2% of its expenses to programs in FY2024</cite>, exceeding standard industry benchmarks. Their fundraising overhead remains exceptionally low, spending just <cite id="1">$0.03 per $1 raised</cite> in charitable support. While the organization delivers massive global health outcomes, its financial footprint experienced a temporary decline in revenue from FY2023 levels. Nevertheless, its strong governance, transparent reporting, and deep roots in international public health make it a notable channel for sadaqah and general global health giving.
